scope: Canvas2D look system on one synthetic fixture. No GPU compositor; shader effect families, keying, time effects and speed ramps are not built.

measurements.distinctBlendResults: 10 of 17 modes give a distinct result when a picture is blended with itself (several are mathematically identical in that special case)

exportWithLooks.note: one 30-frame 640x360 range with a dissolve, a vignette and a colour adjust on this CPU profile; includes job start-up

checks.name: catalog lists exactly what is registered: 12 effects with parameter schemas and defaults, 12 transitions, 17 blend modes
color.grayscale: every pixel is neutral (R=G=B within 2)
color.invert: pixel + original = 255
color.adjust: brightness 0 is black; saturation 0 is neutral
blur.gaussian: the steepest edge is less than half as steep, and the frame edges are not darkened (edge pixels are extended, not faded to transparent)
stylize.pixelate: pixels inside one 36 px block are identical; neighbouring blocks can differ
color.tint (multiply, red, full): green and blue are removed, red is kept
light.vignette: corners are much darker, the centre is untouched
stylize.grain: changes the picture, keeps average brightness, is identical when the same frame is rendered again, and differs on the next frame
digital.rgb-split: red and blue separate at edges (many more pixels with a large red-blue gap); green stays in place
light.diffusion: never darker than the original, brighter overall
bypass and remove both give back the exact original frame
effect order matters and is honoured: tint→grayscale is neutral, grayscale→tint is coloured; the export manifest lists both effects with versions
stylize.shadow on a title: black pixels appear below the letters; the letters themselves stay
keyframed effect parameter: a blur radius animated from 0 to its end value makes the picture progressively softer, holds after the last key, and a frame in the middle is the same when rendered again
difference of a picture with itself is black; add doubles (clamped); multiply squares; screen is the inverse of multiply — all within 2 levels
every blend mode renders without error
checks.detail: 10 of 17 modes give a distinct result when a picture is blended with itself (several are mathematically identical in that special case)

checks.name: ellipse mask: inside is the picture, outside is background; invert swaps them; feather makes a soft edge; the mask moves with the clip
removing the mask restores the exact original frame
dissolve: frame 64 is exactly (1-p)·A + p·B of the two source frames; the frames just outside the transition are untouched
random access: frame 64 rendered alone, and again after rendering other frames, is byte-identical
wipe-left: right of the moving edge is B, left of it is still A
push-left: A slides out to the left while B slides in from the right (compared below the barcode strip; sub-pixel offsets allow small differences)
dip-black: before the midpoint the outgoing picture fades toward black by exactly 2p
zoom: differs from both sides and from a plain dissolve
all 12 transitions render a mid-frame that differs from both sides
no unused source after the previous clip: the transition is refused with the usable length, not faked with a freeze
checks.detail: the previous clip has only 0 unused source frames after its end; the transition needs 10

checks.name: export of a range with a dissolve and two effects: 30 frames, and 9 checked frames match the stills of the same frames (PSNR ≥ 32 dB after H.264)

detail.note: one 30-frame 640x360 range with a dissolve, a vignette and a colour adjust on this CPU profile; includes job start-up

checks.name: agent discovers the catalog, adds an effect, sees it in describe_moment, and gets a clear refusal for an effect that does not exist
editor: add an effect from the catalog, change a generated parameter slider, reorder, bypass, set blend, mask and transition — each lands in the document

Lab: every registered effect, blend mode and transition has tiles drawn by the shared compositor, in 16:9 and 9:16, none blank (except the midpoint of a dip, which is meant to be a flat colour), default and extreme variants differ (where the default is not already the maximum), no page errors
